tools.name: search_leads
tools.description:
Search enriched B2B leads by ICP criteria.

    Returns scored companies with firmographics, tech stack signals, and buying signals.
    Each lead returned counts against the monthly quota.

    Args:
        industries: Filter by industry — AI, Blockchain, Fintech, Security, Healthcare, DevTools, O

tools.name: validate_lead
tools.description:
Check the freshness and website reachability of a specific lead.

    Args:
        lead_id: UUID of the lead to validate

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Return current month quota status and recent usage for the calling API key.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "search_leads" is 796 chars, far longer than this server's median (126). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
